title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00111 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 01:00: WOC. Meanwhile removed tools and equipment from TDS, prepared tools and equipment for n/d diverter and BOP. Moved fishing equipment from cantilever to free up space for 7in TBG. Moved new lifting cap for cementing spool into moonpool.
01:00 - 01:30: WOC. Meanwhile worked to l/o 7in tubing from derrick. Issues with coupling hanging up on upper claw when repositioning PRS at foxhole. Continued to prepare tools and equipment. Continued hosekeeping in shakers.
01:30 - 02:00: WOC. Meanwhile worked to l/o 7in tubing from derrick. Difficulties to breakout connection w/ CSG tong. Continued to prepare tools and equipment. Continued hosekeeping in shakers
02:00 - 03:00: WOC. Meanwhile worked to l/o 7in tubing from derrick. Layed out 1x stand.
03:00 - 03:15: WOC. Meanwhile worked to install bolt on TDS blower cabinet
03:15 - 04:15: WOC. Meanwhile worked to l/o 7in tubing from derrick. Layed out 2x stands.
04:15 - 05:00: Pressure tested surface cement plug against closed shear ram. Attempted to test twice. Pressure broke off around 30-40bar and leaked off. After second attempt started loosing fluid into the well around 1,6m3/hour
05:00 - 16:00: Continued to layout 7in pipe from derrick. Layed out 9x stands. Meanwhile continued w/ maintenance work on TDS and DW. Function tested BOP. Continued preparation to n/d BOP. Losses 1,6m3/hour. Meamwhile evaluated with onshore organization further plans
16:00 - 16:15: Performed pre-job meeting prior to run RTTS plug
16:15 - 18:00: RIH 3x stands 8,25in DC and RTTS BHA. Losses 1,6m3/hour

18:30 - 18:45: Set RTTS plug at 131,5m element). Closed UPR on BOP and lined up cement unit for pressure test below RTTS via drill string. Losses stopped after RTTS packer was set

Pressure tested surface cement plug against closed shear ram. Attempted to test twice. Pressure broke off around 30-40bar and leaked off. After second attempt started loosing fluid into the well around 1,6m3/hour

Continued to layout 7in pipe from derrick. Layed out 9x stands. Meanwhile continued w/ maintenance work on TDS and DW. Function tested BOP. Continued preparation to n/d BOP. Losses 1,6m3/hour. Meamwhile evaluated with onshore organization further plans
Performed pre-job meeting prior to run RTTS plug
RIH 3x stands 8,25in DC and RTTS BHA. Losses 1,6m3/hour

RIH on 5,5in DP to 130 w/ RTTS plug BHA. M/u pup joint for space out and connected TDS. Placed RTTS packer at 131,5m element). Filled pipe and broke circulation. Recorded up/down weights 88t/84t. Losses 1,6m3/hour
Set RTTS plug at 131,5m element). Closed UPR on BOP and lined up cement unit for pressure test below RTTS via drill string. Losses stopped after RTTS packer was set
Pressure tested the surface lines to 125 bar/ 10 min. Attempted to pressure test surface cement plug below RTTS plug. Pressure broke at around 30 bar. Stopped pressuring up. Pressure leaked off.
Released RTTS plug, POOH w/ RTTS BHA, losses 1,6m3/hour
L/d RTTS BHA, r/b 8,25in drill collars. Cleaned drill floor
Performed pre-job meeting to n/d diverter
Removed elevators and rotator. Attached chains to bails. Installed lifting eyebolts to diverter. Pulled diverter to rig floor, 11,5t overpull to come free. Installed outer ring and master bushing
